title: thorn.toml
description: A Tarn project's manifest, read by Thorn, Tarn's package manager.

name.description: How the package is imported (`import name`): a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits and `_`. Not a Tarn keyword or a standard-library module.

version.description: A semantic version, all three parts: `0.1.0`, `1.4.2`, `2.0.0-beta.1`.

description.description: What it does, in one line: shown in search results.

license.description: An SPDX expression, like `MIT` or `MIT OR Apache-2.0`.

keywords.description: Up to 5, for search: lowercase letters, digits and `-`.

readme.description: The README's path in the package (default: README.md).

tarn.description: The compiler versions the package works with, like `>=0.1`.

include.description: More files to publish, as globs (`examples/*.tr`).

exclude.description: Files never to publish, as globs.

dependencies.description: The packages it needs, by name.

path.description: A package in a folder, relative to this file. Give a version too, to be able to publish.
